body.name: E3
body.def: \(\mathcal E_3\) has \(B=3\), one unit per block, \(W=\{2\}\), \(q_2=1\), \(\mathcal Z=\{z_0,z_1\}\), \(A_1=A_3=\{z_0\}\), \(A_2=\{z_0,z_1\}\), deterministic control in blocks \(1\) and \(3\), and history-invariant probabilities \(p_{21}(z_0\mid H_{21})=p_{21}(z_1\mid H_{21})=1/2\)
